blocks.zh: Section 10: Siliconization 矽化處理
blocks.en: Section 10: Siliconization

blocks.zh: 矽油種類、噴塗技術、活塞與針頭矽化、藥品相容性與次可見微粒分析
blocks.en: Types of silicone oil, spray techniques, plunger and needle siliconization, drug product compatibility, and sub-visible particle analysis

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解矽化處理（Siliconization）在 PFS 玻璃注射器中的功能角色：潤滑、屏障與功能性保障
blocks.en: Understand the functional roles of siliconization in PFS glass syringes: lubrication, barrier and functional assurance

blocks.zh: 區分固定噴嘴（Fixed Nozzle）與潛入式噴嘴（Diving Nozzle）矽化方式的分佈均一性與力學性能差異
blocks.en: Distinguish fixed-nozzle from diving-nozzle siliconization in terms of distribution uniformity and mechanical performance

blocks.zh: 掌握 Break-loose Force（起動力）與 Gliding Force（滑動力）的測量原理及規格平衡邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the measurement principles of break-loose force and gliding force and the logic of balancing their specifications

blocks.zh: 了解活塞橡膠塞矽化量與次可見微粒（Sub-visible Particles, USP <788>）計數的關聯性
blocks.en: Understand how the amount of silicone on the plunger stopper relates to sub-visible particle counts (USP <788>)

blocks.zh: 認識矽油特性表徵方法：FTIR、粉末測試、反射量測法（Reflectometry）、Schlieren 效應分析
blocks.en: Become familiar with methods for characterizing silicone oil: FTIR, powder test, reflectometry and Schlieren effect analysis

blocks.zh: 評估矽油對藥品穩定性的潛在影響，包括蛋白質/矽油交互作用與 ICP-OES 定量分析
blocks.en: Assess the potential impact of silicone oil on drug product stability, including protein/silicone interactions and ICP-OES quantitation

blocks.zh: 理解矽化處理與 CCI、保存期限（Shelf Life）及功能性之間的多重平衡關係
blocks.en: Understand the multiple trade-offs between siliconization and CCI, shelf life and functionality

blocks.zh: 10.0 Siliconization 矽化處理
blocks.en: 10.0 Siliconization

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 矽化處理（Siliconization）是 PFS 製程中的關鍵潤滑步驟，主要功能有三：
blocks.en: Siliconization is the key lubrication step in PFS manufacturing and has three main functions:

blocks.zh: 功能性潤滑：確保活塞在玻璃筒身內順暢移動，達到可接受的 Break-loose Force 與 Gliding Force
blocks.en: Functional lubrication: ensures the plunger moves smoothly within the glass barrel and achieves acceptable break-loose force and gliding force

blocks.zh: 屏障作用：矽油膜可隔絕藥液與玻璃直接接觸，降低玻璃析出物（leachables）風險
blocks.en: Barrier effect: the silicone film separates the drug solution from direct contact with the glass, reducing the risk of glass leachables

blocks.zh: 針頭潤滑：降低插針摩擦力，改善注射體驗
blocks.en: Needle lubrication: reduces the friction of needle insertion and improves the injection experience

blocks.zh: Section 10 的核心挑戰在於：矽油量過少則功能失效，過多則引發藥品相容性問題（次可見微粒、蛋白質聚集）。
blocks.en: The core challenge of Section 10 is that too little silicone oil causes loss of function, while too much causes drug product compatibility problems (sub-visible particles, protein aggregation).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 矽油膜就像製藥版的「成膜劑」（film-forming agent）——劑量過低，薄膜不連續，無法潤滑；劑量過高，薄膜脫落，產生「雜質顆粒」。這與外用藥膏的基質用量優化邏輯如出一轍：找到 Minimum Effective Quantity，即最少足量原則。
blocks.en: A silicone film is like the pharmaceutical version of a film-forming agent: at too low a dose the film is discontinuous and cannot lubricate; at too high a dose the film sheds and creates "foreign particles". This is the same logic as optimizing the amount of base in a topical ointment: find the minimum effective quantity, that is, the principle of using the least amount that is sufficient.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本 section 不涵蓋無矽油系統（silicone oil-free systems）。若 Amaran 承接對矽油零容忍的生物製劑（如某些單株抗體），需另行參考替代潤滑或預塗層（pre-coated）解決方案，TR73 不提供該等內容。
blocks.en: This section does not cover silicone oil-free systems. If Amaran takes on a biologic with zero tolerance for silicone oil (such as certain monoclonal antibodies), alternative lubrication or pre-coated solutions must be sought elsewhere; TR73 does not provide this content.

blocks.zh: 10.1 Type of Silicone and Areas of Application 矽油種類與施用部位
blocks.en: 10.1 Type of Silicone and Areas of Application

blocks.zh: 矽油化學品種：聚二甲基矽氧烷（PDMS）為標準矽油，需為醫藥級。黏度選擇依用途而定：
blocks.en: Silicone oil chemistry: polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) is the standard silicone oil and must be of medical/pharmaceutical grade. The viscosity is chosen according to the application:

blocks.zh: 1,000 cSt：低黏度，適用於筒身噴塗，流動性佳，分布較均勻
blocks.en: 1,000 cSt: low viscosity, suited to spraying the barrel; good flowability and more uniform distribution

blocks.zh: 12,500 cSt：高黏度，適用於針頭擦塗，附著力強，不易流失
blocks.en: 12,500 cSt: high viscosity, suited to wiping the needle; strong adhesion and not easily lost

blocks.zh: 法規合規性：需符合 USP、Ph. Eur.、JP 各藥典專論（monograph）要求，是 CMC 文件中矽油規格的法規依據。
blocks.en: Regulatory compliance: must meet the monograph requirements of the USP, Ph. Eur. and JP; this is the regulatory basis for the silicone oil specification in the CMC documentation.

blocks.zh: 固定噴嘴（Fixed Nozzle）就像從罐口向下噴漆——靠近噴嘴處漆厚，遠端漆薄，分布高度不均。潛入式噴嘴（Diving Nozzle）則像油漆滾筒從底部向上均勻滾塗——整個筒身每一節的矽油量都可精確控制，且可依活塞放置位置設計分布profile（矽油劑量分布圖）。
blocks.en: A fixed nozzle is like spraying paint downward from the mouth of a can: the paint is thick near the nozzle and thin at the far end, so the distribution is highly non-uniform. A diving nozzle is like a paint roller working evenly from the bottom upward: the amount of silicone at every segment of the barrel can be precisely controlled, and the distribution profile (silicone dose distribution map) can be designed according to where the plunger is placed.

blocks.zh: Diving Nozzle 的戰略優勢：不僅分布均勻，更可程式化設定矽油分布 Profile。例如：真空放塞工藝在法蘭端需要較多矽油；通氣管（vent tube）放塞工藝在活塞放置區需要較多矽油。這種彈性使 Diving Nozzle 成為現代 PFS 填充線的主流選擇。
blocks.en: Strategic advantage of the diving nozzle: beyond uniform distribution, the silicone distribution profile can be programmed. For example, vacuum stoppering processes need more silicone at the flange end, while vent-tube stoppering processes need more silicone in the plunger placement zone. This flexibility has made the diving nozzle the mainstream choice for modern PFS filling lines.

blocks.zh: 10.1.2 Effects of Fixed-Nozzle Systems 固定噴嘴系統的影響
blocks.en: 10.1.2 Effects of Fixed-Nozzle Systems

blocks.zh: Schlieren 效應（施利倫條紋）：矽油厚度局部不均勻時，在特定背景圖案下，光線因折射率差異產生可見干涉條紋。這是矽油分布可視化的光學方法，是 ZebraSci® 等商用系統的工作原理之一。
blocks.en: Schlieren effect: where the silicone thickness is locally non-uniform, light refracts differently against a specific background pattern and produces visible interference fringes. This is an optical method for visualizing silicone distribution and is one of the working principles of commercial systems such as ZebraSci®.

blocks.zh: 固定噴嘴的力學後果：矽油分布不均直接導致 Gliding Force 曲線在行程後段急劇上升——注射後半段阻力增大，對自動注射器尤其不利，可能導致劑量不準或裝置卡頓。
blocks.en: Mechanical consequences of a fixed nozzle: non-uniform silicone distribution directly causes the gliding force curve to rise sharply in the later part of the stroke. Resistance increases in the second half of the injection, which is especially unfavorable for autoinjectors and can lead to inaccurate dosing or device stalling.

blocks.zh: 固定噴嘴的典型失效模式：Sections 1-3 矽油過多（Schlieren 模式明顯）→ Sections 5-7 矽油嚴重不足（僅有孤立液滴）→ Gliding Force 在行程 25 mm 後顯著上升。這在自動注射器注射行程完整度評估中是高風險失效點，Amaran 接收供應商矽化筒身時應確認噴嘴類型。
blocks.en: Typical failure mode of a fixed nozzle: excess silicone in Sections 1-3 (Schlieren pattern obvious) → severe silicone deficiency in Sections 5-7 (only isolated droplets) → gliding force rises markedly after 25 mm of travel. In assessing the completeness of the injection stroke of an autoinjector this is a high-risk failure point, so Amaran should confirm the nozzle type when receiving siliconized barrels from suppliers.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 固定噴嘴系統在哪種充填工藝條件下可能仍然可接受？請從活塞行程長度和注射速度角度分析。
blocks.en: Under what filling process conditions might a fixed-nozzle system still be acceptable? Analyze from the perspective of plunger stroke length and injection speed.

blocks.zh: 若 Break-loose Force 合格但 Gliding Force 在行程後段超規，應採取哪些矯正措施？
blocks.en: If break-loose force is acceptable but gliding force exceeds specification late in the stroke, what corrective actions should be taken?

blocks.zh: 10.1.3 Effects of Diving Nozzle Systems 潛入式噴嘴系統的影響
blocks.en: 10.1.3 Effects of Diving Nozzle Systems

blocks.zh: 潛入式噴嘴的關鍵性能指標：
blocks.en: Key performance indicators of a diving nozzle:

blocks.zh: 均一的 Gliding Force：整個注射行程（0–50 mm）力值穩定，無行程後段突增
blocks.en: Uniform gliding force: force is stable across the whole injection stroke (0–50 mm), with no sudden rise late in the stroke

blocks.zh: 低 Break-loose Force：初始起動力小，符合 Usability/Human Factors 要求（特別是老年人、關節炎患者）
blocks.en: Low break-loose force: a low initial force meets usability/human factors requirements (especially for elderly users and arthritis patients)

blocks.zh: 矽油總量減少：均勻分布意味著相同功能效果下可減少矽油施用量，降低次可見微粒風險
blocks.en: Reduced total silicone amount: uniform distribution means less silicone is needed for the same functional effect, lowering the risk of sub-visible particles

blocks.zh: Gliding Force 曲線就像抽屜的開合阻力——固定噴嘴系統的抽屜越拉越重（後段阻力激增），而潛入式噴嘴系統的抽屜全程阻力均勻。對自動注射器而言，均勻的力值是裝置可靠性（Device Reliability）的基本前提。
blocks.en: The gliding force curve is like the resistance of opening and closing a drawer: with a fixed-nozzle system the drawer gets heavier as you pull it (resistance surges late in the stroke), whereas with a diving-nozzle system the resistance is even throughout. For autoinjectors, uniform force is the basic prerequisite for device reliability.

blocks.zh: 在自動注射器（Autoinjector）驗證中，Gliding Force 的可接受範圍如何與彈簧力設計關聯？
blocks.en: In autoinjector validation, how is the acceptable range of gliding force linked to the spring force design?

blocks.zh: 若相同注射器改用 Diving Nozzle 後 Break-loose Force 降低 30%，對 CCI 是否有潛在影響？
blocks.en: If break-loose force falls by 30% when the same syringe is switched to a diving nozzle, is there a potential impact on CCI?

blocks.zh: 10.2 PFS Barrel and Plunger Stopper Combination 筒身與活塞橡膠塞組合
blocks.en: 10.2 PFS Barrel and Plunger Stopper Combination

blocks.zh: 活塞橡膠塞矽化的雙重功能：
blocks.en: Dual function of plunger stopper siliconization:

blocks.zh: 機械性（Machinability）：活塞在振動碗（vibrator bowl）和軌道（track）中的自動送料需要矽油潤滑，否則卡料率上升，影響生產效率
blocks.en: Machinability: automatic feeding of plungers in the vibrator bowl and track requires silicone lubrication; otherwise the jam rate rises and production efficiency suffers

blocks.zh: 功能性：活塞插入筒身後的 Break-loose Force 與 Gliding Force 需符合 URS 規格
blocks.en: Functionality: after the plunger is inserted into the barrel, break-loose force and gliding force must meet the URS specification

blocks.zh: 優化策略——高開低走原則：從最高矽油量開始，逐步降低，直至找到既能保障機械性又能符合力學規格且次可見微粒最低的最佳量。
blocks.en: Optimization strategy - the "start high, then reduce" principle: start from the highest silicone amount and reduce it step by step until the optimal amount is found that ensures machinability, meets the force specifications and gives the lowest sub-visible particle counts.

blocks.zh: 活塞矽油量優化就像調整發動機機油量——過多機油（矽油）造成油封漏油（次可見微粒進入藥液）；過少機油導致引擎卡頓（機械性不足、Break-loose Force 過高）。「高開低走」找到最佳潤滑量，正是工程師的核心任務。
blocks.en: Optimizing the silicone amount on the plunger is like adjusting the engine oil level: too much oil (silicone) causes the oil seal to leak (sub-visible particles enter the drug solution); too little oil makes the engine stall (poor machinability, excessive break-loose force). Using "start high, then reduce" to find the optimal lubrication amount is the core task of the engineer.

blocks.zh: 次可見微粒 USP <788> 的關聯性
blocks.en: Relationship to sub-visible particles, USP <788>

blocks.zh: 矽油從活塞橡膠塞釋放進入藥液後，形成微小矽油液滴（silicone oil droplets），這些液滴會被光遮蔽法（Light Obscuration）計數，貢獻至 USP <788> 的 ≥10 μm 和 ≥25 μm 粒子計數。由於光遮蔽法無法區分矽油液滴與其他顆粒類型，PFS 產品的粒子計數往往高於同等藥液的玻璃瓶裝（vial）產品，且變異性更大。這在 Amaran 進行 PFS 放行檢驗時需特別注意，應建立針對 PFS 的粒子計數可接受標準。
blocks.en: When silicone oil is released from the plunger stopper into the drug solution, it forms tiny silicone oil droplets. These droplets are counted by light obscuration and contribute to the ≥10 μm and ≥25 μm particle counts of USP <788>. Because light obscuration cannot distinguish silicone oil droplets from other particle types, particle counts for PFS products are often higher, and more variable, than for the same drug solution in vials. Amaran should pay particular attention to this when performing PFS release testing, and should establish PFS-specific acceptance criteria for particle counts.

blocks.zh: 預塗層活塞的替代方案
blocks.en: Alternative: pre-coated plungers

blocks.zh: 預塗層活塞橡膠塞（Pre-coated Plunger Stopper）：以交聯矽油（cross-linked silicone）± PTFE（聚四氟乙烯）塗層取代液態矽油，可大幅降低矽油液滴釋放。適用於對矽油敏感的蛋白質藥品，但成本較高，需重新進行相容性驗證。
blocks.en: Pre-coated plunger stopper: replaces liquid silicone oil with cross-linked silicone ± PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) coating, which greatly reduces the release of silicone oil droplets. It is suitable for silicone-sensitive protein drugs, but is more costly and requires compatibility to be re-validated.

blocks.zh: 若客戶產品的 USP <788> ≥10 μm 粒子計數在 PFS 格式下明顯偏高，如何設計降低矽油貢獻的研究方案？
blocks.en: If the USP <788> ≥10 μm particle count of a customer's product is markedly high in the PFS format, how would you design a study to reduce the silicone contribution?

blocks.zh: 預塗層活塞橡膠塞相比液態矽油活塞，在 CCI 和 E&L 評估上有何差異需要額外考慮？
blocks.en: Compared with a liquid-silicone plunger, what additional differences must be considered for a pre-coated plunger stopper in CCI and E&L assessments?

blocks.zh: 10.3 PFS Barrel and Needle-Shield Combination 筒身與針頭護罩組合
blocks.en: 10.3 PFS Barrel and Needle-Shield Combination

blocks.zh: 矽化處理的三向力學平衡（針頭護罩端）：
blocks.en: Three-way mechanical balance of siliconization (needle shield end):

blocks.zh: Pull-off Force（拔除力）：患者/HCP 拔除護罩所需的力，需在人因工程（Human Factors）可接受範圍
blocks.en: Pull-off force: the force the patient/HCP needs to remove the shield must be within the range acceptable for human factors

blocks.zh: CCI 保障：活塞過度潤滑會導致活塞在運輸振動中向前滑動，破壞針頭端密封完整性
blocks.en: CCI assurance: over-lubricating the plunger can let it slide forward during transport vibration and compromise the integrity of the seal at the needle end

blocks.zh: RNS 分離力 vs 拔除力：RNS 的塑料外殼拔除力必須小於彈性體護罩整體拔除力，否則「脫帽不拔針」，造成使用者傷害
blocks.en: RNS separation force vs pull-off force: the pull-off force of the plastic outer shell of the RNS must be lower than the pull-off force of the elastomeric shield as a whole; otherwise the cap comes off but the shield stays on the needle, injuring the user

blocks.zh: 供應商通常已完成此三向平衡優化，但當 Amaran 變更矽化參數（如提高活塞矽油量以改善機械性時），必須重新評估對針頭護罩拔除力和 CCI 的影響。這是典型的連鎖變更風險（change cascade risk），應納入變更管控程序（Change Control）。
blocks.en: Suppliers have usually already optimized this three-way balance, but when Amaran changes siliconization parameters (for example, increasing the plunger silicone amount to improve machinability), the impact on needle shield pull-off force and CCI must be re-evaluated. This is a typical change cascade risk and should be included in the change control procedure.

blocks.zh: 若活塞矽油量增加 20%，預期對針頭護罩 Pull-off Force 有何影響？請說明機理。
blocks.en: If the plunger silicone amount is increased by 20%, what effect on needle shield pull-off force is expected? Explain the mechanism.

blocks.zh: RNS 的塑料外殼脫帽力如何在設計上確保始終小於彈性體拔除力？
blocks.en: How does the design ensure that the cap-removal force of the plastic outer shell of the RNS is always lower than the pull-off force of the elastomer?

blocks.zh: 10.4 Siliconization of the Injection Needle 注射針頭矽化
blocks.en: 10.4 Siliconization of the Injection Needle

blocks.zh: 針頭矽化的技術特點：
blocks.en: Technical features of needle siliconization:

blocks.zh: 高黏度矽油（12,500 cSt）：附著力強，不易在針頭表面流失；低黏度矽油在細針頭（如 29G、30G）上容易在儲存中流向針尖甚至阻塞針頭
blocks.en: High-viscosity silicone oil (12,500 cSt): strong adhesion, not easily lost from the needle surface; low-viscosity silicone oil on fine needles (such as 29G and 30G) tends to flow toward the needle tip during storage and may even block the needle

blocks.zh: 擦塗工藝（Wiping Process）：為主流工藝，但矽油消耗快，需頻繁補充——這是製程中的 GMP 管控點，應建立補充頻率的標準操作程序（SOP）
blocks.en: Wiping process: the mainstream process, but silicone consumption is fast and frequent replenishment is needed. This is a GMP control point in the process, and a standard operating procedure (SOP) for the replenishment frequency should be established

blocks.zh: 針頭矽化直接影響穿刺力（Penetration Force），是 Human Factors 研究中的重要評估指標。在 Amaran 進行 PFS 功能性驗證時，針頭矽化量的一致性需納入過程中控制（IPC）參數。擦塗工藝的矽油消耗速率應建立警戒限與行動限。
blocks.en: Needle siliconization directly affects penetration force, an important evaluation parameter in human factors studies. When Amaran performs PFS functional validation, the consistency of the needle silicone amount should be included as an in-process control (IPC) parameter. Alert and action limits should be established for the silicone consumption rate of the wiping process.

blocks.zh: 10.5 Drug Product Requirements 藥品需求
blocks.en: 10.5 Drug Product Requirements

blocks.zh: 矽化處理是藥品的一部分：PFS 的矽化條件屬於一次包裝系統規格，必須在代表商業化最終配置的包材條件下完成穩定性研究。這意味著：
blocks.en: Siliconization is part of the drug product: the siliconization conditions of the PFS are part of the primary packaging system specification, and stability studies must be completed with packaging representing the final commercial configuration. This means:

blocks.zh: 穩定性樣品的矽油種類、用量、分布必須與商業批次一致
blocks.en: The type, amount and distribution of silicone oil in stability samples must be consistent with commercial batches

blocks.zh: 若開發期間更改矽化供應商或工藝，需評估對穩定性研究代表性的影響
blocks.en: If the siliconization supplier or process is changed during development, the impact on the representativeness of the stability studies must be assessed

blocks.zh: 功能性評估的觸發節點：開發期（Extended Characterization）、製造操作、儲存、運輸後均需評估功能性。Amaran 應在技術協議中明確各節點的功能測試計畫。
blocks.en: Trigger points for functionality assessment: functionality must be assessed during development (extended characterization), after manufacturing operations, after storage and after transport. Amaran should define the functional testing plan for each of these points in the technical agreement.

blocks.zh: 矽油與活性成分的交互作用（drug/silicone interaction）是 Section 14.0（藥品相容性）的重點內容。蛋白質藥物（如 mAb）可能因矽油界面誘發蛋白質聚集（protein aggregation），這是監管機構在生物製劑 PFS CMC 審查時的必查項目。Amaran 作為 CDMO 必須要求客戶提供藥品與矽油相容性研究的技術文件。
blocks.en: The interaction between silicone oil and the active ingredient (drug/silicone interaction) is a key topic of Section 14.0 (drug product compatibility). Protein drugs (such as mAbs) may undergo protein aggregation induced by silicone oil interfaces, an item that regulators always check in the CMC review of biologic PFS. As a CDMO, Amaran must require customers to provide technical documentation of drug product/silicone oil compatibility studies.

blocks.zh: 10.6 Shelf-life Effects 保存期限效應
blocks.en: 10.6 Shelf-life Effects

blocks.zh: 空針儲存方向的 GMP 管控要點：
blocks.en: GMP control points for syringe storage orientation:

blocks.zh: 針尖朝上儲存：防止矽油因重力積聚在針頭開口，導致針頭阻塞或矽油栓塞
blocks.en: Store needle up: prevents silicone oil from accumulating at the needle opening under gravity, which can cause needle blockage or silicone plugs

blocks.zh: 穩定性項目清單：CCI、可見異物（Visible Particles）、次可見微粒（USP <788>）、理化穩定性、微生物品質（無菌試驗、內毒素）均需納入
blocks.en: Stability test list: CCI, visible particles, sub-visible particles (USP <788>), physicochemical stability and microbiological quality (sterility test, endotoxin) must all be included

blocks.zh: 矽油在儲存期間的再分布（redistribution）是關鍵風險。Section 10.7.3（反射量測法）顯示，水平儲存的注射器底部矽油量可達頂部的 10 倍以上。Amaran 在空針接收和中間儲存的 SOP 中，必須明確規定儲存方向並記錄，以確保矽化分布的一致性延續至填充前。
blocks.en: Redistribution of silicone oil during storage is a key risk. Section 10.7.3 (reflectometry) shows that in syringes stored horizontally the amount of silicone at the bottom can be more than 10 times that at the top. Amaran's SOPs for syringe receipt and intermediate storage must specify and record the storage orientation to ensure that the consistency of the silicone distribution is maintained up to filling.

blocks.zh: 10.7 Methods Toolbox 分析方法工具箱
blocks.en: 10.7 Methods Toolbox

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 五種方法速覽
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Overview of Five Methods

blocks.zh: FTIR（傅里葉紅外光譜）：定量矽油含量，可用於橡膠表面直接測量；萃取法較準確但耗時
blocks.en: FTIR (Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy): quantifies the silicone content and can measure directly on the rubber surface; the extraction method is more accurate but time-consuming

blocks.zh: 粉末測試（Powder Test）：最直觀的可視化方法，低成本，適合 R&D 篩選；無法定量
blocks.en: Powder test: the most intuitive visualization method, low cost, suitable for R&D screening; not quantitative

blocks.zh: 反射量測法（Reflectometry）：可測量矽油層厚度與徑向分布，用於 R&D；不適用批次放行
blocks.en: Reflectometry: measures silicone layer thickness and radial distribution, used in R&D; not suitable for batch release

blocks.zh: Schlieren 效應分析：快速、定性，可視化矽油液滴界面；僅用於 R&D
blocks.en: Schlieren effect analysis: rapid and qualitative, visualizes the silicone droplet interface; for R&D only

blocks.zh: Break-loose / Gliding Force 測量：最直接的功能評估方法；Break-loose 需要 24–72 hr 平衡時間
blocks.en: Break-loose / gliding force measurement: the most direct method of functional assessment; break-loose requires 24–72 hr of equilibration time

blocks.zh: Break-loose Force 測量的時間陷阱
blocks.en: The timing trap in break-loose force measurement

blocks.zh: Break-loose Force 不能在活塞放置後立即測量，必須等待 24–72 小時（實時條件）或使用氣候箱加速老化。原因：活塞在放置後會繼續「適應」矽油膜及玻璃筒身，力值在初期持續變化。若測量時間點不一致，數據無法比較。Amaran 在建立 IPC 方法時，必須在 SOP 中明確規定測量時間窗口。
blocks.en: Break-loose force must not be measured immediately after plunger placement; one must wait 24–72 hours (real-time conditions) or use accelerated aging in a climatic chamber. The reason is that after placement the plunger continues to "settle" into the silicone film and glass barrel, and the force keeps changing in the early period. If measurement time points are inconsistent, the data cannot be compared. When establishing IPC methods, Amaran must specify the measurement time window in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 空氣中測量的局限性
blocks.en: Limitations of measuring in air

blocks.zh: Break-loose/Gliding Force 測試是在空針（注入空氣）條件下進行，而非注入組織或其他接近組織的介質。實際注射時的阻力受流體黏度、注射速度、皮下組織阻力的影響，與空氣測試結果有系統性偏差。這是 Specification 設定時需要工程判斷的關鍵認知。
blocks.en: Break-loose/gliding force tests are performed on empty syringes (injecting air), not into tissue or a medium approximating tissue. In actual injection, resistance is affected by fluid viscosity, injection speed and subcutaneous tissue resistance, so there is a systematic bias against the air test results. This is a key point requiring engineering judgment when setting specifications.

blocks.zh: Amaran 在接收供應商矽化筒身時，應選擇哪種方法進行入廠（Incoming Goods）管制？請評估各方法的適用性。
blocks.en: Which method should Amaran choose for incoming goods control when receiving siliconized barrels from suppliers? Assess the suitability of each method.

blocks.zh: 若反射量測法顯示水平儲存筒身的底部矽油量是頂部的 10 倍，這對 Break-loose Force 的測量方向有何啟示？應如何在測試 SOP 中規定測量位置？
blocks.en: If reflectometry shows that the silicone amount at the bottom of a horizontally stored barrel is 10 times that at the top, what does this imply for the measurement orientation of break-loose force? How should the measurement position be specified in the test SOP?

blocks.zh: 10.8 Measuring Silicone Oil in Solutions 藥液中矽油量測
blocks.en: 10.8 Measuring Silicone Oil in Solutions

blocks.zh: 矽油進入藥液的三種途徑：
blocks.en: Three routes by which silicone oil enters the drug solution:

blocks.zh: 充填操作機械脫落：充填針頭衝擊、泵浦脈衝造成筒壁矽油薄膜局部剝落
blocks.en: Mechanical shedding during filling operations: impact of the filling needle and pump pulses cause local stripping of the silicone film from the barrel wall

blocks.zh: 振動儲存脫落：運輸振動使矽油膜破裂，形成液滴釋放
blocks.en: Shedding during vibration in storage: transport vibration breaks the silicone film and releases droplets

blocks.zh: 活塞推進推擠：注射時活塞推壓矽油薄膜，將矽油推向針頭，部分進入藥液
blocks.en: Displacement by plunger advancement: during injection the plunger pushes the silicone film toward the needle, and some enters the drug solution

blocks.zh: ICP-OES 定量矽油：矽（Si）是矽油的特徵元素，ICP-OES 可偵測藥液中的溶解矽，間接反映矽油分散量。靈敏度高，是目前主流的藥液矽油定量方法。
blocks.en: ICP-OES quantitation of silicone oil: silicon (Si) is the characteristic element of silicone oil, and ICP-OES can detect dissolved silicon in the drug solution, indirectly reflecting the amount of dispersed silicone oil. It is highly sensitive and is currently the mainstream method for quantifying silicone oil in drug solutions.

blocks.zh: 矽油進入藥液就像炒鍋的不沾塗層在高溫翻炒中的局部剝落——翻炒（振動、衝擊）越激烈，剝落的塗層顆粒越多，最終進入食物（藥液）。ICP-OES 就像用化學方法檢測食物中的特氟龍成分，判斷是否超標。
blocks.en: Silicone oil entering the drug solution is like the non-stick coating of a frying pan flaking off locally during high-heat stir-frying: the more vigorous the stir-frying (vibration, impact), the more coating particles flake off and end up in the food (drug solution). ICP-OES is like using a chemical method to test the Teflon content of food to decide whether it exceeds the limit.

blocks.zh: 毒理學角度的安全性評估：即使矽油液滴進入藥液並被注射入患者體內，在正常 PFS 矽化水平下，矽油量遠低於毒理學相關劑量（toxicologically relevant dose）。但監管機構仍要求進行評估並在 CTD 中提供文件。
blocks.en: Safety assessment from a toxicological perspective: even if silicone oil droplets enter the drug solution and are injected into the patient, at normal PFS siliconization levels the amount of silicone oil is far below a toxicologically relevant dose. Regulators nevertheless require an assessment and documentation in the CTD.

blocks.zh: 蛋白質 / 界面活性劑 / 矽油的三角交互作用：治療性蛋白質（mAb、融合蛋白）及其製劑中的界面活性劑（如 PS80）可穩定矽油液滴的分散態，使矽油液滴更難沉降（更難被過濾或檢測除去）。這種穩定效應是 PFS 蛋白質製劑特有的風險，需在配方開發階段評估。
blocks.en: Three-way interaction of protein / surfactant / silicone oil: therapeutic proteins (mAbs, fusion proteins) and the surfactants in their formulations (such as PS80) can stabilize the dispersed state of silicone oil droplets, making them harder to settle (harder to remove by filtration or detection). This stabilizing effect is a risk specific to PFS protein formulations and must be assessed during formulation development.

blocks.zh: 10.8.1 Subvisible Particle Analysis 次可見微粒分析
blocks.en: 10.8.1 Subvisible Particle Analysis

blocks.zh: USP <788> 的強制性要求：所有注射用藥品均需進行光遮蔽法次可見微粒測試（≥10 µm 和 ≥25 µm 計數）。PFS 產品因矽油液滴貢獻，計數通常高於同等藥液的玻璃瓶產品，且批次間變異性更大。
blocks.en: Mandatory requirement of USP <788>: all injectable drug products must undergo sub-visible particle testing by light obscuration (≥10 µm and ≥25 µm counts). Because of the contribution of silicone oil droplets, counts for PFS products are usually higher than for the same drug solution in vials, with greater batch-to-batch variability.

blocks.zh: 流動顯微鏡（Flow Microscopy / MFI）的鑑別優勢：矽油液滴呈球形（Spherical），其他粒子（蛋白質聚集體、玻璃碎片）呈不規則形（Amorphous）。MFI 的形態學分析可區分兩者，提供「矽油液滴計數」vs「其他粒子計數」的分解數據，是 PFS 產品擴展表徵（Extended Characterization）的重要工具。
blocks.en: Discriminating advantage of flow microscopy (flow imaging / MFI): silicone oil droplets are spherical, whereas other particles (protein aggregates, glass fragments) are irregular (amorphous). The morphological analysis of MFI can distinguish the two and provides a breakdown into "silicone oil droplet counts" vs "other particle counts", making it an important tool for the extended characterization of PFS products.

blocks.zh: 光遮蔽法就像用手電筒照汽車排氣管——只能感測到「有顆粒」，但無法區分是煤灰（蛋白質聚集體）還是油滴（矽油液滴）。流動顯微鏡則像高畫質攝影機——可以看清每顆粒子的形狀，從而分類計數。對於 PFS 的法規申報，監管機構越來越要求提供這種「形態學鑑別」的擴展數據。
blocks.en: Light obscuration is like shining a flashlight at a car exhaust: it can only sense that "there are particles" but cannot tell whether they are soot (protein aggregates) or oil droplets (silicone oil droplets). Flow microscopy is like a high-definition camera: it shows the shape of each particle so they can be classified and counted. For PFS regulatory submissions, regulators increasingly require this kind of extended "morphological discrimination" data.

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical points for Taiwan CDMOs

blocks.zh: Amaran 在接受 PFS 填充產品時，應在技術協議中要求客戶提供：
blocks.en: When accepting PFS filling projects, Amaran should require the customer to provide the following in the technical agreement:

blocks.zh: 次可見微粒可接受標準（需考慮矽油液滴貢獻的 PFS 特定標準）
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria for sub-visible particles (PFS-specific criteria that take the silicone oil droplet contribution into account)

blocks.zh: 流動顯微鏡（MFI/Flow Imaging）擴展表徵計畫（若為蛋白質製劑）
blocks.en: Extended characterization plan by flow microscopy (MFI/flow imaging) (for protein formulations)

blocks.zh: 矽油液滴與其他粒子的分解計數作為穩定性研究的監測項目
blocks.en: Breakdown counts of silicone oil droplets vs other particles as a monitoring item in stability studies

blocks.zh: 次可見微粒超規是 PFS 批次拒絕的常見原因，且矽油液滴計數的高變異性使規格制定具有挑戰性，應在工藝驗證前充分積累數據。
blocks.en: Out-of-specification sub-visible particle results are a common cause of PFS batch rejection, and the high variability of silicone oil droplet counts makes setting specifications challenging; sufficient data should be accumulated before process validation.

blocks.zh: 若 MFI 分析顯示某批 PFS 的球形粒子（矽油液滴）佔總次可見微粒的 80%，光遮蔽法計數超規，應如何處理？這是否必然導致批次拒絕？
blocks.en: If MFI analysis shows that spherical particles (silicone oil droplets) make up 80% of the total sub-visible particles of a PFS batch and the light obscuration count is out of specification, how should this be handled? Does this necessarily lead to batch rejection?

blocks.zh: 「烘烤矽油（Baked-on Silicone）」系統相比游離矽油（Free Silicone Oil）系統，在矽油液滴釋放量上有何優勢？其對次可見微粒計數有何影響？
blocks.en: What advantage does a baked-on silicone system have over a free silicone oil system in the amount of silicone oil droplets released? What is the effect on sub-visible particle counts?

blocks.zh: 在設定 PFS 產品的 USP <788> 可接受標準時，應收集哪些基準數據？與相同藥液玻璃瓶裝的標準如何對應？
blocks.en: When setting USP <788> acceptance criteria for a PFS product, what baseline data should be collected? How do they correspond to the criteria for the same drug solution in vials?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 矽化處理目標是在最少矽油量下確保全棚架生命週期（Shelf Life）的功能性，同時最小化對藥品的衝擊。固定噴嘴系統因分布不均，已逐漸被潛入式噴嘴系統取代。
blocks.en: The goal of siliconization is to ensure functionality throughout the shelf life with the least amount of silicone oil while minimizing the impact on the drug product. Fixed-nozzle systems, because of their uneven distribution, have been gradually replaced by diving-nozzle systems.

blocks.zh: Break-loose Force 與 Gliding Force 是矽化質量的核心功能指標。潛入式噴嘴可實現均勻力值曲線，是自動注射器的必要條件。Break-loose Force 測量需 24–72 hr 平衡時間，不可省略。
blocks.en: Break-loose force and gliding force are the core functional indicators of siliconization quality. A diving nozzle can achieve a uniform force curve, which is a necessary condition for autoinjectors. Break-loose force measurement requires 24–72 hr of equilibration time, which must not be skipped.

blocks.zh: 活塞矽油量需平衡機械性（Machinability）、功能性（Force）與次可見微粒（USP <788>）三者。優化策略為「高開低走」——從最高量逐步降低至最佳量。
blocks.en: The plunger silicone amount must balance machinability, functionality (force) and sub-visible particles (USP <788>). The optimization strategy is "start high, then reduce": reduce step by step from the highest amount to the optimal amount.

blocks.zh: 矽油分布會隨儲存方向和時間再分布——空針須針尖朝上儲存；水平儲存可使底部矽油量達頂部 10 倍以上。
blocks.en: Silicone distribution redistributes with storage orientation and time: syringes must be stored needle up; horizontal storage can make the silicone amount at the bottom more than 10 times that at the top.

blocks.zh: 藥液中矽油的影響分兩個維度：（1）次可見微粒計數偏高（USP <788> 合規風險）；（2）蛋白質/矽油交互作用（聚集風險）。MFI 流動顯微鏡是鑑別矽油液滴與其他粒子的關鍵擴展表徵工具。
blocks.en: The impact of silicone oil in the drug solution has two dimensions: (1) elevated sub-visible particle counts (USP <788> compliance risk); (2) protein/silicone interactions (aggregation risk). MFI flow microscopy is the key extended characterization tool for distinguishing silicone oil droplets from other particles.

blocks.zh: 分析方法選擇依用途而異：FTIR 和力學測試可用於批次放行；反射量測法和 Schlieren 分析僅限 R&D；ICP-OES 用於藥液矽油定量。
blocks.en: The choice of analytical method depends on the purpose: FTIR and mechanical testing can be used for batch release; reflectometry and Schlieren analysis are limited to R&D; ICP-OES is used to quantify silicone oil in the drug solution.

blocks.zh: Section 10: Siliconization 矽化處理 | p51–p59 (PDF p58–p66)
blocks.en: Section 10: Siliconization | p51–p59 (PDF p58–p66)
